sources.role: 256 train, 128 validation, 100 test; publisher splits retained

sources.role: Up to 512 isolated samples from publisher test; whole source held out
sources.notes: Six-digit labels including leading zeroes preserved as strings; real versus synthetic origin unspecified

sources.role: Initial whole-source test retained; later add 200 publisher-train and 128 publisher-validation examples with answer/pixel isolation

limitations: Pretrained OpenOCR corpus overlap is unknown
Results already inspected are diagnostic and cannot be called fresh blind tests
Current model supports alphanumeric text, not all interactive, Chinese or arithmetic CAPTCHA tasks
